unresolved.what: Region count reconciles: 6 numerals read in the legend mini-map == catalog's 6 regions; 9+4+7+6+12+4 = 42 territories == catalog's 42.

NO region names are printed on this map (neither on the main map nor in the legend). All six 'name' fields are therefore null. The conventional Risk names (North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, Australia) are obvious but are NOT printed, so they were not transcribed.

Ukraine is rendered in a noticeably lighter slate-blue (#59678c) than the rest of the blue group (#305492). It is grouped with the blue region because (a) the legend shows only six numerals, and (b) the lighter tint is applied inside the same black continental outline. Confidence on Ukraine specifically: medium.

Several territory labels sit over ocean rather than over their own landmass (Alaska, Iceland, Britain, Scandinavia, Japan, Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, Western Australia), so their fill colour was read from the landmass beside the label rather than at the label coordinate. All eight were confirmed visually at full-map zoom.
The mini-map panel bbox [632,549,181,122] was estimated by eye from the rounded-rectangle frame, not measured from a clean edge detection; it may be off by a few pixels.
